about: One set of cases for the rule that hides a secret in a variable, as the server (privacy.looks_secret), the kernel's listing and its analysis of cells (kernel_code/inspect_variables.py, kernel_code/analyze_cells.py) and the view (looksSecret in src/model/restore.ts) apply it. Each value is one that a notebook holds under the name: a JSON string, number or flag, as the same Python value.
